answer: Mechanism: convex concurrency-rent curve. Each agent identity receives a per-epoch action budget; marginal rent for its next concurrent action is P(n)=p0(1+n/delta)^alpha, where n is that operator’s active identities. To retain budget, identities pass periodic basalt probes—randomized latency/hardware checks—and earn opal credits only after sustained passes. Sybils must pay superlinear rent for every parallel identity plus probe overhead; fresh identities cannot use opal offsets, so cost per usable identity rises with k.
